description: Packaging-only aggregation of original independent runs on task version 1.2.0. No new execution, run ID, score, response or task checksum has been created. Control trials (oracle/nop) and candidate model trials were produced by the local Outside-Harbor runner (deliverables/2026-10-04_outside-harbor-win/runner/runner.py) and are archived verbatim.
original_download_note: 返修的上游是 v1.1.0 交付包（被本地质检以模型原始证据不足打回）；本归档是 v1.2.0 上的替代证据集，两者不是同一个包。
parent_zip_note: 本 jobs 树随 v1.2.0 交付 zip 一起分发，zip 的 sha256 见同名 .sha256 文件；lock.json 位于 zip 内部，无法记录自身容器的 hash

task_hash_runner_algorithm: sha256 over (relative posix path + NUL + sha256(file) + LF) for every file sorted by path, excluding jobs/, runs/, work/, results/ and caches (same as runner.py compute_task_hash; this is the value every trial's agent/task_identity.json records)
